description: Export an exact SAVED project snapshot as a portable template package. Supply idempotencyKey, expectedRevision, name, new slug and optional bounded mediaParams/textParams selectors for existing clip/leaf sites. Reads actual saved composition/components/media through the maintained extractor; no caller document, source, sample URL or provenance assertions. Returns a durable library-export job; poll get_template_job until ready, then pass its receiptId to get_template_package_download. An existing slug conflicts. A project-bound editor may export only its bound project. Does not render or create a new project.

mediaParams.description: Call describe_tool_input with tool "export_template_package" and field "mediaParams" for the exact JSON Schema.

textParams.description: Call describe_tool_input with tool "export_template_package" and field "textParams" for the exact JSON Schema.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: export_template_package
